meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'spare, hold back'.

examples.text: И секретного ингредиента не жалей.
examples.trans: And do not spare the secret ingredient.

examples.text: Секретного ингредиента не жалей!
examples.trans: Do not spare the secret ingredient!

examples.text: Шеф не жалеет специй для соуса.
examples.trans: The chef does not spare spices for the sauce.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'in, into', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Что самое важное в работе официанта?
examples.trans: What is the most important thing in a waiter's job?

examples.text: Манеры? Вежливость?
examples.trans: Manners? Politeness?

examples.text: Эффектная подача блюд делает их вкуснее.
examples.trans: Spectacular presentation of dishes makes them tastier.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('shared, common').

examples.text: Я тоже в общую кассу положил.
examples.trans: I also put money into the common pool.

examples.text: Если так будешь разговаривать, вообще ничего не получишь.
examples.trans: If you talk like that, you will get nothing at all.

examples.text: В общем, как себе.
examples.trans: In short, just like for yourself.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to oneself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вы что себе позволяете?
examples.trans: How dare you?

examples.text: В общем, как себе.
examples.trans: In short, just like for yourself.

examples.text: Я чувствую себя хорошо.
examples.trans: I feel good.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тупать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'go on, off you go'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и ступать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and go on on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют ступать.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to go on.
